note: Task 01a17bf4 stage 1: before-run for the smaller-first-frame work. LOCAL seeded dev server (apps/platform/priv/scripts/seed_tab_switch_fixture.exs, user tabswitch, busy channel tab-switch-busy with 2,000 messages) behind the byte proxy shaped 9 Mbps down / 1.5 Mbps up / 85 ms RTT (proxy shaper primary, as docs/perf/tab-switch-baseline.md Stage 3), permessage-deflate on, 10 measured taps per tab after one warm-up, desktop 1280x800, Logger :info on the node. Not prod. Units: tap/ready ms; bytes are bytes; server enter_space segment durations are microseconds (from :telemetry.span native units). first_frame_wire_bytes = the bytes the link carried for the join reply message alone (frame headers + compressed payload), matched by decompressing the proxy stream; wire_down_bytes = every server->client byte on /live in the tap window.
